asymmetry_rules: Avoid 3x3 identical grids. Use mixed span ratios: Hero grid 7:5, Feature cards 8:4 or 4:8, staggered product cards.
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text/image border collision.
Hero and key highlight sections use organic SVG candy shapes and subtle floating blobs behind transparent product cutouts.

motion_and_interactions.section_reveal: Fade up with y: 30, duration: 0.6s, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]

circular_orbit.description: Products revolve smoothly around a center brand hub. Hovering or clicking a product pauses orbit, enlarges the active product, and displays product details with CTA. Touch drag enabled on mobile.

motion_and_interactions.draggable_rail: Horizontal smooth drag carousel with snap points and active scale effect

motion_and_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: All motion transitions switch to simple opacities when prefers-reduced-motion is true

media.display_strategy: Never crop text or faces in posters. Use object-contain or object-cover with padded containers and background ambient colors extracted from image tone.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure the app has dir='rtl' set on the root level html/wrapper.
2. Inject Lalezar and Alexandria Google Fonts in public/index.html or index.css.
3. Use tailwind utility classes with RTL awareness (e.g. space-x-reverse, flex-row-reverse where applicable, or native RTL flex flow).
4. Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
5. Use framer-motion for high-end micro-interactions, floating product physics, modal popups, category filtering animations, and orbit carousel controls.
6. Every interactive button, link, tab, filter, and input MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-products', data-testid='category-btn-jelly').
7. Do NOT invent fake numbers or generic corporate filler. Keep company history accurate to Palestine/Jenin confectionery import and marketing.
8. Check header backdrop-blur glass effect ensuring high contrast and readable text on light backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set data-testid on interactive elements in kebab-case format.
Ensure contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1 for standard text and 3:1 for large display headlines.
Hover states must explicitly specify text color alongside background changes (e.g., hover:bg-red-600 hover:text-white).
Do not use dark gradients across the entire page; keep the foundation crisp off-white/cream with rich colorful candy accents.
Use sonner for toast notifications on contact form submission.
Ensure full mobile responsiveness with custom touch drawer or menu overlay for mobile navigation.
